name: Silver X Mining Corp.
summary: Silver X Mining Corp., established in 2009 and headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, explores for and develops mineral assets across the Americas. Formerly Oro X Mining Corp., it has a major interest in the Nueva Recuperada silver, lead and zinc project in Huancavelica, Peru, and a stake in the Coriorcco gold project in the Ayacucho region of Peru.
